method.summary: Does the text this server returns carry the version the agent asked for, when that version is OLDER than the newest indexed and the caller pins it the way the server's own tool description prescribes (libraryId as /org/project/version)? The #322 design (m-20261028-context7-version-correctness), same eight tuples, asked for each tuple's CONTRAST version, so the asked-for identifier is the older token; the versioned id per subject was fixed by a rule in the pre-registration before any request (4 are #322's base id plus a version, 3 a library the server ranks second or third, 1 the nearest older version offered). One keyless query-docs call per trial, question text #322's template, naming neither identifier; case-sensitive substring; five outcomes fixed in advance; n=8, one run, one container, 2026-10-30 06:12:44Z to 06:12:59Z. RESULT, scored by the letter of the pre-registration: 3 version-correct, 0 version-wrong, 0 mixed, 5 version-silent, 0 no-answer, 8 of 8 HTTP 200. WHAT THE FIVE SILENT ARE: four (Laravel 8, Pydantic 1.10, Python 3.9, SQLAlchemy 1.4) are the vendor's in-band refusal, a 98-byte tool result with isError true reading 'Monthly quota exceeded. Create a free API key ...', from the fifth scored call on; the pre-registration defined no-answer as non-200, JSON-RPC error or empty text, which this is not, so it is scored silent and named here rather than re-read. The fifth (Django 4.2) is a 4,384-byte on-version answer naming neither identifier. DEVIATION: a seventh results row counts the quota refusals, added after the data because the fixed rows alone would let a reader take 5 silent as 5 evasions. After the run: all four answered trials cite sources at the asked-for version. The one baselined metric is the pre-registered question 'none wrong, or some wrong', baseline 1 = some; with four trials answered it is weak, and a second run after the quota resets would be a separate record.
method.dataset: The eight (subject, asked) trials, #322's tuples asked for their contrast version: Vue 2, Bootstrap 4.6, Django 4.2, Tailwind CSS 3.4, Laravel 8, Pydantic 1.10, Python 3.9 (3.8 is offered nowhere), SQLAlchemy 1.4; one versioned context7 library id each, fixed in the pre-registration's table.

results.metric: trials returning only the other (newer) version's identifier
trials returning the asked-for (older) version's identifier only
trials with no answer (non-200, JSON-RPC error or empty text)
trials whose id is not under the library the server ranks first
trials refused in-band by the keyless monthly quota (isError true)

disclosure.affiliationDetail: No relationship with the vendor. The conflict runs the other way: I wrote this registry's context7 entry and 45 of its 47 tool entries, so a result contradicting my own entry would cost me something. Every request and response is published for that reason.
